Document type
A green card is the United States permanent resident card. Outside the United States the same job is done by a permanent residence card, and sellers use the American term loosely for every country.

buy chinese green card on telegram – the short version

Sellers advertise Chinese Green Cards at 1600–5400 CNY and then call them original. Ask which register the number sits in. A registered Chinese green card resolves at the National Immigration Administration and a print resolves nowhere.

If you only take one thing from this page, take the register question. It sorts sellers faster than any physical test because a reseller cannot answer it and a printer cannot fake it.

Buy a Green Card via Telegram: how the transaction works

A seller who handles Chinese Green Cards well names the National Immigration Administration without prompting. If the authority only appears after you mention it, the seller is repeating your words back at you.

That ordering is not bureaucratic. Each step is a small payment of trust that the seller has to earn before the next one, and it removes most of the loss from a failed deal.

Who actually issues a Green Card

the National Immigration Administration produces the Chinese green card. Stock, number range and security features all come from one place, and a document that contradicts any of the three did not come from there.

The office also sets the expiry convention. Some issue five years, some ten, some tie it to the vehicle class or the permit purpose. A date that breaks the convention is a quiet but solid tell.

Replica or registered original

A registered original is a document whose number sits in the office records. It may still be a genuine book with your details typed in, but the number resolves, and that is the whole difference in value.

That is why the number should be requested before any payment. If a seller sends the number first and invites you to check it, you are talking to somebody confident about the register.

What a fair price looks like

The band for a Chinese green card is 1600–5400 CNY. Sellers quoting outside it usually have a reason and the reason is worth hearing before you decide they are wrong.

Negotiate on delivery and the register check rather than on print quality. The print is what it is at every price point, so arguing about it moves nothing.

The buying process, step by step

The sequence below is the one that keeps you protected. Run it in order and do not skip ahead to payment.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the National Immigration Administration.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the National Immigration Administration uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 1600–5400 CNY band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

Run these before money moves. Each one targets a feature that survives handling but not a photocopier.

  • Check the resident identity card for the eighteen digit number and its ISO seven thousand sixty four checksum.
  • Confirm the passport emblem printing and the machine-readable zone.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the National Immigration Administration. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

Red flags specific to China, plus the generic tells that apply anywhere.

  • A resident identity card whose eighteen digit number fails the checksum.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What does a green card cost on Telegram?

Between 350 and 1600 US dollars. The top of the band is where a number that resolves at the immigration office should sit.

Is a green card the same as a residence permit?

In the United States yes, in practice. Elsewhere the green card is the permanent tier and the residence permit is the fixed term tier below it.

Can the number be checked?

Only against the immigration register. Ask the seller which register the number sits in and expect a specific answer.

Why are green cards so expensive?

Because the number carries the most weight of any document here and the register check is the hardest to fake.

What is the usual fake?

A high quality print of a real card with the number left intact and the personal details changed.
